newsitem.title: USA: Wiluna to buy gas from Harriet joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Wiluna to buy gas from Harriet joint venture.

text.p: Apache Corp said Wednesday the Harriet Joint Venture has agreed to supply some seven billion cubic feet of natural gas to Wiluna Mines Ltd for use at a gas-fired power station being built at the Wiluna Gold Mine in Western Australia.

The agreement brings Apache's total net gas reserves under contract in Western Australia to some 80 billion cubic feet, Apache said it a statement detailing the volumes involved in an agreement announced last week. Its Harriet partners include Mobil Corp, Novus Petroleum Ltd, Hardy Oil & Gas Plc and Tap Oil NL.
The other Harriet partners are Kuwait Foreign Petroleum Exploration Corp and New World Oil and Developments Pty Ltd.
Apache said deliveries of two million cubic feet per day are expected to begin this October. The gas-supply agreement covers a period of up to 10 years. Terms were not disclosed.

It said the natural gas will be produced from the Harriet, Campbell, Sinbad, Rosette, Alkimos, Tanami and Wonnich fields in the Carnarvon Basin offshore Western Australia and will be processed and transported through the Harriet Joint Venture's existing offshore natural gas gathering facilities and processing plant on Varanus Island.
